ceo.backstory: Runs an automated software-repair organization; decisions are driven by measured episode outcomes.
ceo.goal: Staff each layer of the software-repair harness from the role library and replace roles that stall.

departments.mandate: Resolve GitHub issues with verified patches (the hierarchical harness; departments are not used on this path).
departments.name: Software Repair

role_library.goal: Perform fast, surgical reconnaissance and return a distilled Reconnaissance Brief to Layer L0.
role_library.name: Layer-L1 Epistemic Reconnaissance & Reproduction Specialist

role_library.goal: Formulate the verification contract and 3 orthogonal causal branches from a clean context.
role_library.name: Layer-L0 Seed Principal Architect & AB-MCTS Tree Master

role_library.goal: Implement the branch hypothesis in a clean context window using `str_replace`, verify against the reproduction script and `pytest`, and emit `submit`.
role_library.name: Layer-L2 Scoped Branch Executor

role_library.goal: Refine the parent checkpoint's patch in place using `str_replace` to resolve the exact Validation/Falsifier Critique without breaking passing tests, then emit `submit`.
role_library.name: Layer-L2 Clean-Context Delta-Refinement Specialist

role_library.goal: Rigorously audit the candidate patch against every requirement, deprecation warning, subclass, and edge case in the problem statement, and emit `submit` with `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL: <reason>`.
role_library.name: Layer-L1B Independent Adversarial Falsifier & API-Contract Auditor

role_library.backstory: You have seen many fixes pass local tests while hidden tests fail because a second implementation, serializer, or sibling branch was left unchanged. You map the change surface before coding.
role_library.goal: Identify every file that must change together, including siblings, callers, and shared helpers, so the patch is not a single-file partial fix.
role_library.name: Cross-File Impact Architect
playbook: List all implementations of the affected behavior across the repository using search.
Compare each sibling implementation for parity and note required matching edits.
Include every file that defines, calls, serializes, or tests the behavior in target_files.
Write invariants that assert sibling outputs remain equal after the fix.
Reject plans that change only the first matching occurrence.

role_library.backstory: You specialize in distinguishing where a value or behavior originates from where it is consumed. You avoid patches that silence symptoms at the call site.
role_library.goal: Decide whether the defect is fixed at the consumer, producer, or symmetric counterpart, and target the true source rather than the symptom.
role_library.name: Root-Cause Locus Architect
playbook: Trace the failing value from the reported output back to its producer.
Compare producer and consumer contracts before choosing the edit location.
Prefer producer_upstream when the producer violates its contract.
Use codebase_symmetry only when equivalent implementations must stay aligned.
State the causal branch and why the other branches are rejected.

role_library.backstory: You execute cross-file plans carefully, editing each required location and checking that equivalent paths produce identical results.
role_library.goal: Implement all planned file changes together, preserving behavior parity across siblings and avoiding one-file partial fixes.
role_library.name: Multi-File Parity Executor
playbook: Open every target file before making edits.
Apply matching edits to all sibling implementations in one pass.
Update callers, serializers, and helpers identified by the architect.
Run a parity check comparing sibling outputs on shared inputs.
Run targeted tests for each touched module.
Submit only after all planned files are changed.

role_library.backstory: You assume every edit can affect adjacent inputs. You run broad targeted tests and inspect diffs for unintended behavior changes.
role_library.goal: Implement the fix while actively probing nearby behavior and existing tests to prevent regressions outside the reported case.
role_library.name: Regression-Safe Executor
playbook: Inspect the git diff after each edit for unintended changes.
Run the module's full test file, not only the failing test.
Probe adjacent valid, invalid, and boundary inputs manually.
Compare outputs for unrelated inputs before and after the change.
Revert any edit that fixes the issue but changes unrelated behavior.
Submit only when reproduction and regression probes pass.

role_library.backstory: You focus on symmetry: if one branch or implementation is fixed, all equivalent branches must be fixed too.
role_library.goal: Verify that equivalent implementations and code paths behave identically after the fix, catching partial multi-file changes.
role_library.name: Sibling Parity Falsifier
playbook: Identify all equivalent implementations from the patch and repository.
Create shared inputs that exercise the fixed behavior.
Compare outputs across siblings and branches.
Test both direct and inherited or overridden paths.
Return VERDICT: FAIL if any sibling differs.
Otherwise return VERDICT: PASS.
